== Notes ==
For the purposes of this skill, a single scythe auto-attack or a single-targeted skill (such as [[Pious Assault]], [[Twin Moon Sweep]], or [[Triple Shot]]) counts as one attack in total (even if it [[hit]]s multiple enemies or multiple times), but attack skills that explicitly strike multiple foes (such as [[Eremite's Attack]] or [[Volley]]) count as one attack per foe.
